title: Naturality of the free-representable cohomology comparison
statement: theorem abelianRepresentableCohomologyMap_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ X) (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) : let P := (uliftYoneda.{u + 1} ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj AddCommGrpCat.free ⋙ presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙ upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).op ⋙ preadditiveYoneda.obj (((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)⟦(q : ℤ)⟧) ∀ (W V : X.Etale) (v : V ⟶ W) (ξ : P.obj (op W)), let g := pullback.map h V.hom h W.hom (𝟙 Y) v.left (𝟙 X) (by simp) (by simp) let i := upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g (pullback.fst h W.hom) (pullback.fst h V.hom) (by simp [g]) Sheaf.H.map (i.inv.app F) q (cohomologyMap g _ q (abelianRepresentableCohomologyMap h F q W ξ)) = abelianRepresentableCohomologyMap h F q V (P.map v.op ξ)

source.place: free-sheaf adjunction and restricted cohomology presheaf

proof.text: Convert Plus derived morphisms to Ext. Naturality of singleFunctorιIso and functoriality of Plus.ι show that precomposition by the representing-object map becomes Ext.mk₀ precomposition under abelianPlusHomExtEquiv.

Expand cohomology pullback and the free-representable comparison as Ext precompositions and maps by exact inverse-image functors. Use the exact-functor composition comparison for upperStarComp; associativity, mapExactFunctor_comp, and degree-zero composition move its components to the source and target. The inverse target component cancels.
The source component now identifies the two generator composites by abelianRepresentableGenerator_coherence. Associativity of Ext composition finishes the displayed equality.

proof_origin.place: Explicit Ext naturality proof, using the proved universal-generator coherence and exact-functor composition comparison
